reasons.nakshatra_vivaha: Chandra {nakshatra} nakshatra mein hai, jo shaadi ke liye shastra-sammat gyarah nakshatron mein se ek hai.
reasons.nakshatra_not_vivaha: Chandra ka nakshatra ({nakshatra}) shaadi ki classical list mein nahin hai.
reasons.nakshatra_vivaha_secondary: Dharmasindhu ke hisaab se {nakshatra} shaadi ke liye theek hai, agar koi dosh na ho.
reasons.pushya_curse: Pushya lagbhag har kaam ke liye shubh hai, bas shaadi ke liye nahin, isliye yeh slot ke khilaaf gina gaya.
reasons.nakshatra_rejected: {nakshatra} shaadi ke liye varjit hai (ugra ya tikshna nakshatra).
reasons.magha_mula_first_pada: Magha aur Mula ka pehla charan shaadi mein taala jaata hai.
reasons.tithi_good: {tithi} tithi is kaam ke liye achhi hai.
reasons.rikta_tithi: {tithi} Rikta tithi hai, shuruaat ke liye nahin.
reasons.tithi_avoid_vivaha: Raman ki parampara mein Ashtami aur Purnima shaadi ke liye taali jaati hain.
reasons.tithi_avoid_event: {tithi} is kaam ke liye taali jaati hai.
reasons.purnima_avoid: Griha pravesh ke liye Purnima taali jaati hai.
reasons.shukla_paksha: Shukla paksha shuruaat ko bal deta hai.
reasons.shukla_paksha_extra: Is sanskar ke liye Shukla paksha behtar hai.
reasons.vara_good: {vara} is kaam ke liye saumya vaar hai (vaar ka weight sabse kam hota hai).
reasons.vara_avoid: {vara} krur vaar hai, halke mein khilaaf gina gaya.
reasons.vara_saturday_north: North India mein griha pravesh ke liye Shanivaar chhoda jaata hai.
reasons.masa_excellent: {masa} maas is kaam ke liye sabse achhe maason mein hai.
reasons.masa_good: {masa} maas is kaam ke liye anukool hai.
reasons.masa_avoid: {masa} maas griha pravesh ke liye aam taur par taala jaata hai.
reasons.sarvartha_siddhi: Sarvartha Siddhi yoga: yeh vaar aur nakshatra milkar sab kaam siddh karte hain.
reasons.amrita_siddhi: Amrita Siddhi yoga chal raha hai (vaar aur nakshatra ka sanyog).
reasons.siddha_yoga: Siddha yoga: vaar aur tithi ka achha mel.
reasons.ravi_yoga: Ravi yoga kai chhote dosh hata deta hai.
reasons.abhijit: Abhijit muhurta (dopahar ke aas-paas ka aathvan muhurta) is slot ko bal deta hai.
reasons.amrit_kaal: Is nakshatra ka Amrit kaal chal raha hai.
reasons.choghadiya_avoid: Choghadiya {choghadiya} hai, jo aam taur par taala jaata hai.
reasons.choghadiya_char_travel: Char choghadiya yatra ke liye sahi hai.
reasons.tara_good: Aapke janma nakshatra se Tara bala achha hai.
reasons.tara_bad: Aapke janma nakshatra se Tara bala theek nahin (Vipat, Pratyari ya Vadha tara).
reasons.chandra_good: Chandra bala achha hai: Chandra aapki janma rashi se shubh sthaan mein hai.
reasons.chandra_avoid: Chandra bala kamzor hai: Chandra aapki janma rashi se 4th, 8th ya 12th mein hai.
reasons.panchaka: Panchak chal raha hai (Chandra aakhri paanch nakshatron mein), North India mein maana jaata hai.
reasons.panchaka_south_travel: Panchak: dakshin disha ki yatra taali jaati hai.
reasons.panchaka_pillar: Panchak: khambha uthana aur chhat daalna taala jaata hai.
reasons.inauspicious_yoga: {yoga} yoga un nau yogon mein hai jo shuruaat ke liye varjit hain.
reasons.vara_tithi_dosha: Yeh vaar aur tithi Dagdha, Visha ya Hutashana yoga banaate hain.
reasons.mrityu_yoga: Mrityu yoga: vaar aur tithi-group ka mel theek nahin.
reasons.yamaghanta: Yamaghanta: yeh vaar aur nakshatra taale jaate hain, khaaskar yatra mein.
reasons.varjyam: Is nakshatra ka Varjyam chal raha hai.
reasons.bhadra_other_loka: Bhadra chal rahi hai par {loka} lok mein, jo nirdosh maani jaati hai; pandit ji ke liye note kiya.
reasons.nakshatra_dhruva: {nakshatra} Dhruva (sthir) nakshatra hai, sthayi kaamon ke liye best.
reasons.nakshatra_griha: {nakshatra} griha pravesh ke liye approved hai.
reasons.nakshatra_not_griha: {nakshatra} griha pravesh ki list mein nahin hai.
reasons.nakshatra_ugra_tikshna: {nakshatra} ugra ya tikshna nakshatra hai, shubh kaam mein use nahin hota.
reasons.nakshatra_good: {nakshatra} is kaam ke liye approved hai.
reasons.nakshatra_unlisted: {nakshatra} is kaam ki preferred list mein nahin hai.
reasons.nakshatra_avoid: {nakshatra} is kaam ke liye taala jaata hai.
reasons.pushya_business: Business shuru karne ke liye Pushya pehli pasand hai.
reasons.ravi_guru_pushya: Ravi Pushya ya Guru Pushya yoga: vyapaar aur kharidari ke liye uttam.
reasons.abujha_muhurta: Yeh abujha muhurta ka din hai; muhurta dekhne ki zaroorat nahin.
reasons.gand_mool: Chandra Gand Mool nakshatra mein hai.
reasons.janma_nakshatra_avoid: Chandra aapke janma nakshatra (Janma tara) mein hai, is sanskar ke liye taala jaata hai.
reasons.uttarayana: Surya Uttarayana mein hai, sanskaron ke liye behtar.
reasons.hora_mercury_jupiter: Hora Budh ya Guru ki hai, vidya ke liye achhi.
reasons.pushkara_asset: Tripushkara ya Dwipushkara yoga: jo abhi mile woh badhta hai.
reasons.guru_asta: Guru ast hai (Surya se {separation}° ke andar): shaadi nahin ki jaati.
reasons.shukra_asta: Shukra ast hai (Surya se {separation}° ke andar): shaadi nahin ki jaati.
reasons.adhika_masa: Yeh Adhik (mal) maas hai, jisme shubh kaam shuru nahin kiye jaate.
reasons.kharmas: Kharmas: Surya {sunRashi} (Dhanu ya Meena) mein hai, shaadi aur griha pravesh ke liye ek mahine ka viraam.
reasons.chaturmas: Chaturmas (Devshayani se Devutthani Ekadashi): shaadi aur griha pravesh Vishnu ke jaagne tak rukte hain.
reasons.holashtak: Holashtak, Holi se pehle ke aath din, taale jaate hain.
reasons.pitru_paksha: Pitru paksha, purvajon ka pakhwada, shuruaat ke liye nahin hai.
reasons.eclipse_window: Grahan ke aas-paas ke varjit kaal mein ({daysFromPeak} din).
reasons.sankranti_window: {rashi} sankranti (Surya ke rashi parivartan) ke bahut kareeb.
reasons.amavasya: Amavasya: amavasya tithi mein shuruaat nahin ki jaati.
reasons.bhadra_martya: Bhadra (Vishti karana) martya lok mein: shubh kaam ke liye din ka sabse bada block.
reasons.vyatipata_vaidhriti: {yoga} yoga sab shuruaaton ke liye varjit hai.
reasons.gandanta: Gandanta: Chandra jal aur agni rashi ki sandhi par hai.
reasons.chandrashtama: Chandrashtama: Chandra aapki janma rashi se 8th mein hai, yeh hard block hai.

caveats.family_pandit: Ise ek shortlist maanein. Aapke kul purohit aapka gotra, sutak aur kul-achar jaante hain, jo koi app nahin jaan sakta.
caveats.lagna_shuddhi_v3: Lagna shuddhi (shaadi lagna ke 21 mahadosh) abhi check nahin hoti; lagna pandit ji se tay karayein.
caveats.partner_bala_v3: Sirf ek vyakti ka Tara aur Chandra bala liya gaya hai; partner ka baad mein judega.
caveats.weekday_least_weight: Vaar ka weight sabse kam hai; Guru/Shukra ast aur Bhadra sabse bade block hain.
caveats.vastu_shanti_before: Pravesh se pehle Vastu shanti karayein; kalash ke saath daahina pair pehle.
caveats.lagna_fixed_sign_v3: Sthir lagna behtar hai; lagna abhi compute nahin hota.
caveats.general_pack: Yeh event general rule pack se aanka gaya hai: nakshatra lists shastron se hain, par shaadi aur griha pravesh jitni fine-tuning abhi nahin.
caveats.purnimanta_month_name: North Indian (purnimanta) maas ke naam dikhaye gaye hain; Gujarati, Marathi aur South Indian panchang Krishna paksha ko pichhle maas ke naam se kehte hain.
caveats.birth_time_unknown: Janma samay agyaat: us din Chandra ek hi nakshatra mein raha, isliye result bharosemand hai.
caveats.birth_time_unknown_ambiguous: Janma samay agyaat aur us din Chandra ne nakshatra badla: dono options dikhaye gaye hain, result approximate hai.
caveats.no_birth_details: Tara bala aur Chandra bala jodne ke liye janma details dein.
caveats.drive_east_or_north_first: Pehle east ya north ki taraf chalayein.
caveats.abhijit_wednesday: Kai paramparaon mein Budhvaar ko Abhijit nahin liya jaata.
caveats.sthira_lagna_v2: Sthir lagna ka window lagna ganana aane par judega.
caveats.gujarati_new_year: Bestu Varas: aaj Gujarati Vikram Samvat shuru hota hai.
caveats.chaturmas_ends_weddings_resume: Chaturmas khatam; shaadi ka season shuru.
